finding: A package created later in clock time can still be semantically stale when it was commissioned from an earlier founder-intent source and never consumed the later direct correction.
operating_rule: Determine currentness from admitted source chronology and proposition coverage, not file creation time or successful hash verification.
proof_or_recheck: SC-CIEG v004 cites Founder Intent blob a9cf2476cb09aebce3d98fd4b5b7d40c0d5a8d61 and omits the later voice delta.

finding: Projects with good instructions but weak source packs, automation, tools, legacy learning and propagation remain below the required enterprise standard.
operating_rule: A project is not delivered until current shared and project-specific sources, operating routes, lifecycle, automation and continuity are present and verified.
proof_or_recheck: Project-by-project estate recovery and source-pack receipts required.

finding: Strong research or production performance from SW can be laundered into a strategic or governing role that Ahmed did not grant.
operating_rule: Commission SW as a minimal-context production/research tool for Ahmed; classify and independently integrate its outputs without conferring strategic authority.
proof_or_recheck: Future SW commissions and destination receipts.

finding: A message can be accurate in isolation yet fail because it does not identify the actual recipient, context, capabilities, source route, authority, format or return path.
operating_rule: Every material inter-model commission is destination-aware and includes principal, function, decision changed, minimum context, source route, authority, output schema, receipt and fallback.
proof_or_recheck: Successor model-routing contract and matched cross-surface receipts.

finding: An inaccessible or token-expensive connector can be treated as the only route, causing avoidable stop states, cost and founder burden.
operating_rule: Compare strongest, most cost-efficient adequate and fallback routes; separate access from authority and continue unaffected work.
proof_or_recheck: Successor route-economy matrix and execution receipts.

finding: Large estates accumulate sources, agents, launches, receipts and documents without systematically extracting learning or removing low-value state.
operating_rule: Legacy recovery must change operating objects or justify no change; documentation uses structured economical forms; retention, archive and deletion follow dependency, rights and recovery gates.
proof_or_recheck: Legacy-learning register, project-source changes and controlled lifecycle receipts.
